turns.text: Hey Lloyd, can you check if my order for the new mechanical keyboard switches has shipped yet?
I'll check that for you right now. Give me a moment to look up the tracking status.
Thanks. Also, did you see the latest robotics leaderboard updates? Qwen-RobotManip topped the RoboChallenge Table30 v1 Generalist Track with a process score of 59.83 and ~45% task success.
Noted. That's a strong showing. The switches are still in processing, though the carrier updated the status an hour ago.
Okay, let me know when it ships. I'm thinking of ordering some hot sauce tonight.
Will do. What kind of hot sauce are you eyeing?
Lloyd, I'm trying to organize my research notes. Can you remind me what category Qwen-RobotManip falls into?
Sure. Based on your previous notes, Qwen-RobotManip is a generalist manipulation model.
Right, I just wanted to confirm. I'm also looking for a good pasta recipe for dinner.
I can suggest a few. Do you prefer tomato-based or cream-based?
Tomato-based. And make sure the note about the model is saved under 'Generalist'.
Saved. Here is a classic Arrabbiata recipe...
